currentRoundInspection.scope: Four useful actually inspected exterior/courtyard pictures and normal viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys or redistributed pictures.

pictures.author: A.Savin, Wikipedia
pictures.license: Free Art License for photograph;viewed only
pictures.observed: Inspected960×960 overall exterior. Four very slender pale minarets have three projecting balconies and dark pointed caps; a broad grey main dome crowns descending windowed half-domes and smaller corner caps. Pale coursed walls,stepped buttress bases,raised platform,side two-storey loggia and broad approaches define the massing.

pictures.author: brewbooks
pictures.observed: Inspected960×720 WSW exterior. Central projecting side loggia has an open pointed lower arcade and an upper band of dark rectangular windows under a shallow grey roof. Flanking raised pointed door portals and broad stairs,arched upper windows,parapet rhythm,capped corner turrets and the cascading windowed dome drums are visible. The Commons courtyard category does not make this an inside-court picture.

pictures.date: 2018-05-17 metadata;uploader notes some views are older scans
pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Inspected full960×651 entry-flank view. Raised pointed timber door in a broad stone recess,lower rectangular and upper pointed windows,tapered minaret pedestal,broad split stairs and side loggia. Fine inscriptions and stone patterns are not copied;picture date/current finish are qualified.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Inspected960×618 inner courtyard. Tall pointed arcade on pale columns,two tiers of opaque rectangular openings and a raised central pointed entry;low circular basin with hemispherical lattice cover. Temporary overhead framing and construction materials are visible and omitted. Original generic geometric cap/rails approximate the basin;no copied artwork or claim about present roof cover.
